t.zh: 检查证明项的，是证明器的核。这几个证明项是别人写的，都声称证出了要证的那句。先点检查，看核怎么说，再把它们改对。
t.en: What checks a proof term is the prover’s kernel. These terms were written by someone else, each claiming to prove its sentence. Check first and see what the kernel says, then put them right.

after.zh: 核只看类型，不管证明项是谁写的、怎样找到的。证明项留下来，谁都能再查一遍。
after.en: The kernel looks only at types, not at who wrote a term or how it was found. A proof term kept can be checked again by anyone.
